description: US nuclear power reactor status from the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission's daily Power Reactor Status Report: each unit's power level (% of rated) on the latest report day and the day before, with counts of units at full power, reduced and offline (refueling or outage). US units only (about 94); worldwide IAEA PRIS data is not included. Filter by part of the unit name. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_ercot_texas_grid_status when you need Live Texas grid status from ERCOT's public dashboards. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Optional: part of a unit name, e.g. Vogtle or Diablo
